hypotheses.root_cause: Interconnect transaction timed out under fabric congestion: A low-priority initiator is starved of QoS credits
hypotheses.rationale: Sustained high transaction-queue occupancy and stalls precede a transaction timeout and interconnect failure, suggesting QoS starvation or a potential deadlock on a congested route. Evidence contains the tell-tale(s) 'qos credit starvation', 'credits=0' for RC_NOC_QOS_STARVATION.
recommended_actions: Rebalance QoS weights / credits for the starved initiator
Enable age-based arbitration on the congested link
Review NoC QoS/arbitration weights for the starved initiator
Check for dependency cycles / deadlock on the congested route
